canonical_agent_feedback_contract.producer_ownership: The same AlgorithmEngineer, SimulationEngineer, TheoryDeveloper, or Formalizer that authored a rejected candidate receives the complete parent candidate, raw validator or execution errors, exact environment observations, and immutable lineage.
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.revision_action: The producer regenerates a complete new candidate. Runtime never patches source, chooses a mathematical fix, supplies Lean grammar or tactic recipes, or substitutes a hidden repair agent.
runtime_responsibilities: return raw compiler, LSP, proof-state, sandbox, and validator observations
preserve candidate identity and hash lineage
enforce independent review and kernel evidence boundaries
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.lean_aci: replace_lean_source, search_formal_environment, check_lean_source, and submit_compiled_source are model-controlled tools. The runtime stores and checks exact model-authored source; it does not edit Lean.
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.structured_output_regeneration: The historically named llm_json_repair helper is a same-model generation loop, not a repair tool: it sends the original request, complete previous response, and raw validator errors back to the producer and validates the complete regenerated object. It performs no local semantic repair.
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.failed_candidate_path: A validator, safety, execution, or metric failure returns directly to the same producing model with the complete candidate and raw observations. It does not detour through GeneratedCodeSemanticReviewer. Independent semantic review is an acceptance boundary for candidates that pass their current execution and metric gates.
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.exhausted_lineage_path: When the unchanged candidate lineage reaches its configured regeneration budget, that producer is omitted only from the immediate Architect route. The Architect model may select any remaining existing evidence producer or record a blocker; a materially new parent artifact starts a fresh lineage.
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.architect_routing_input: Architect sees raw current/superseded observations plus an allowlisted control-plane projection: artifact IDs and hashes, progress, evaluation phase, feedback-loop counts, and candidate-lineage budget. Legacy runtime replan prose and owner recommendations are not model input.
canonical_agent_feedback_contract.forbidden_model_context: Runtime-authored fix recipes, repair-owner recommendations, tool-order recipes, theorem-family patches, and Lean syntax or tactic recipes are stripped from model-facing observations.
